Access.name: isProtectionSpecialistEsterno
Access.Query:
select case when count(*) = 0 then 'N' else 'S' end as isProtectionSpecialistEsterno from PRGM_USERS_ROLES_COMPLETE where C_USER =
codAgenteCollegato and P_ROLE = 2260

Access.name: loadPdfKeyFromApplReference
Access.Query: select PDF_CODE, PDF_ENVIRONMENT, ACROFORM_VERSION from PDF_APPL_REFERENCED_CODE where APPL_REFERENCE = ?

Access.name: loadPdfIdFromCode
Access.Query: select PDF_ID, MOM_CODE from PDF_ANAG where CODE = ?

Access.name: loadPdfIdFromMomCodeOnCatalog
Access.Query: select PDF_ID, CODE , case when AREA = 'CATALOGO_OPERAZIONI' then 1 else 2 end from PDF_ANAG where MOM_CODE = ? and AREA in ('CATALOGO_MODULI','CATALOGO_OPERAZIONI') order by 3 asc

Access.name: loadPdfIdFromMomCode
Access.Query: select PDF_ID, CODE from PDF_ANAG where MOM_CODE = ?

Access.name: loadCodeFromPdfId
Access.Query: select CODE from PDF_ANAG where PDF_ID = ?

Access.name: initPdfCurrentPubblicationId
Access.Query:
select top 1 PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION where PDF_ID =
pdfId and (IS_ARCHIVED is null or IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and START_DATE <= getdate() and MOM_VERSION =
momVersion and ACROFORM_VERSION =
acroformVersion order by START_DATE desc, PUBLISH_TIME desc

Access.name: loadPdf
Access.Query: select top 1 CONTENT from PDF_PUBLICATION where PDF_ID = ? and PUBLICATION_ID = ?

Access.name: loadPdfOnWork
Access.Query: select top 1 CONTENT from PDF_PUBLICATION_WORK where PDF_ID = ?

Access.name: loadPdfPageImage
Access.Query: select top 1 PAGE_IMG from PDF_PAGE where PDF_ID = ? and PUBLICATION_ID = ? and PAGE_NUM = ?

Access.name: loadPdfPageImageOnWork
Access.Query: select top 1 PAGE_IMG from PDF_PAGE_WORK where PDF_ID = ? and PAGE_NUM = ?
